title: Reset your password
content: To reset a password, choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter the email address on the account. Use the secure reset link sent by email. Reset links expire after 30 minutes. Support agents must never ask a customer to share their password or one-time verification code.

title: Billing and duplicate charges
content: A pending card authorization can appear alongside a completed charge and usually disappears when the bank releases it. Ask the customer to check whether both entries are posted. For two posted charges, collect the dates and amounts and escalate to Billing for investigation. Never promise a refund or request full card details.

title: Cancel a subscription
content: Customers can turn off renewal in Account settings > Plan > Cancel renewal. Access continues until the end of the current paid period. Cancellation does not automatically issue a refund. If the customer cannot access the account, route the request to Support for identity verification.

title: Export account data
content: Go to Settings > Privacy > Export my data and confirm the request. A download link is sent to the verified account email when the export is ready. Exports can take up to 48 hours. Do not send account data to an email address that is not verified on the account.

title: Report a suspicious sign-in
content: If a customer reports a sign-in they do not recognize, advise them to reset their password from the official sign-in page and review active sessions in Security settings. Never request passwords or one-time codes. Escalate suspected account takeover to the Security queue immediately.

title: Change account email
content: Customers can update their email in Account settings after confirming their password and verifying the new email address. If they can no longer access the existing email, do not change it manually; route to the account recovery team for identity checks.
